name: Outcast Necromancers
summary: A Magram in the Valley of Bones wants you to kill Gelkis outcasts who meddle with forbidden powers. Their exile has brought them into conflict with the Magram.

sections.title: Outcasts in the Canyon
sections.body: A Magram asks you to deal with Gelkis outcasts in the Valley of Bones. The Magram have made a foothold deeper in the canyon, and some Gelkis followed them there. Their clan has sentenced them to exile, while the Magram do not know whether they mean to join or overthrow them. The Magram call them lone wolves who meddle with powers that do not belong to them.

sections.title: The Magram's Grievance
sections.body: The Magram want the outcasts dead and say the Gelkis should have dealt with their own kin. They see the exiles as a burden left by an inferior clan, and warn that any more should be killed. Their demand rests on the feud between the clans and the outcasts' forbidden dealings.

faq.answer: They are Gelkis exiles meddling with powers the Magram say do not belong to them.
Their Gelkis clan sentenced them all to exile after some followed the Magram into the canyon.

faq.q: What does the Magram want from me?
faq.answer: The Magram wants you to kill the Outcast Necromancers in the Valley of Bones.

faq.q: Why does the Magram want them dead?
faq.answer: The Magram calls them lone wolves meddling with powers that do not belong to them.

faq.q: Do the outcasts want to join the Magram?
faq.answer: The Magram does not know whether the exiles want to join or overthrow them.
